description: reputation is her villain era and I was LIVING for it 😤🔥 'Look What You Made Me Do', '...Ready for It?', 'Getaway Car', the whole 'there will be no explanation there will just be reputation' energy. She said 'you hate me? fine, I'll be the snake' and it was ICONIC. The dark electropop is everything and the Tom/Joe lore is juicy. This album made me a worse person and I love it for that 💅✨
